correctness.rationale: For every positive parameter sextuple with a2<u_-<u_+ two distinct F(u)=a4/a3 roots, exact symbolic cancellation gives dH/dt=(u-u_+)(F(u)-v*)=-a1(u-u_+)^2(u-u_-)/(u+b2). Each relative-entropy term is nonnegative and proper. H<B forces u>u_- and makes H nonincreasing on a compact positive sublevel; LaSalle then gives convergence to E_+. B is the exact minimum of H on u=u_- and is the largest entire-entropy-sublevel half-space certificate, not the actual basin threshold. Periodic integration forces strict crossing of u_-, and logarithmic means plus strict F concavity force mean prey between roots. Standalone exact SymPy checks and one numerical solution passed; numerical evidence is not substituted for proof.

value.rationale: Bistability makes initial-condition basin selection central. The result gives an explicit positive-volume three-dimensional initial-data region with rigorous all-time survival and convergence despite competing extinction; it quantifies the greatest full entropy sublevel provably above the lower coexistence root. Conditional recurrence crossing further constrains possible coexistence oscillations. It is not a routine local Jacobian statement, arbitrary parameter slice, or finite simulation and makes no claim about an exact full basin.
